title: Continuity (wind-down and handover)
summary: Soft halt lists open commitments by party and due time; the owner reassigns them (commitments CLI) or notifies parties (external gate, category message); the soft halt does not report settled while a breach-able commitment is unowned.
enableWhen: there are live obligations to outside parties

tools.purpose: wind-down and handover: open commitments by party and due, unowned ones, reassign, notify a party (gated)

meters.why: notices to parties queued during a wind-down (each with its clearance)
